Privacy & website use

Privacy, in plain language.

This page explains what happens when you browse this website, prepare a project brief or use one of our contact links.

Browsing this website

The pages are delivered through the website’s hosting provider. Hosting and access services may process connection information to deliver and protect the website. Where this hosted version requires sign-in, that access step is handled by the platform.

Your display preference

When you choose Day or Night mode, this website saves that choice in your browser’s local storage under ap-tech-theme. This lets the same theme appear on other pages and when you return. You can remove the preference by clearing this website’s browser data.

Project briefs and chat drafts

The project form and chat panel prepare a message in your browser. This website does not submit the message to an AP Tech enquiry database or send it automatically. Drafts are not saved by the website after you leave or reload the page, although your browser may remember form fields through its own features.

If you choose Copy or Download, the brief goes to your clipboard or a file on your device. Keep those copies according to your own needs.

WhatsApp and email

Choosing Continue on WhatsApp places the prepared message in a WhatsApp link and opens WhatsApp. Choosing Open email draft opens your email application with the project details. Review the content before sending. The message content is passed to the service you choose, and that service’s own privacy practices apply.

When you send us an enquiry, we use the information you provide to discuss the project and respond. Please avoid including passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information in an initial brief.

External websites and the client portal

Project links and the client portal open separate websites. The portal handles its own accounts, authentication and project records. This website does not collect your portal password.

Website information and project agreements

Service descriptions explain the kind of work we offer. Your written project proposal or agreement defines the actual scope, price, responsibilities and delivery arrangements. Case studies describe specific contributions and do not promise the same result for every project.

Questions about your information

Contact info@aptechagency.com with a question about information you have shared with the team.
